stories.summary: The Pentagon is in talks with General Motors, Ford and other manufacturers to help mass-produce drones, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing people familiar with the matter.
stories.why: General Motors and Ford are major automakers with large manufacturing capacity, and defence contracts can open new revenue lines for industrial companies.

stories.headline: Zelensky confirms Ukraine attacked a Russian vessel in the Gulf of Finland; Norway calls for caution
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy confirmed his country was responsible for a drone attack on a Russian cargo ship in the Gulf of Finland. Norway called for caution.
stories.why: Attacks on shipping in the Baltic region affect maritime trade routes and insurance costs, and they add to geopolitical risk for Europe and Russia.

stories.headline: China investigates Chen Jining, Party secretary of Shanghai and Politburo member

stories.headline: Bangladesh's export receipts from Germany, France fall by nearly $678m in FY26
stories.summary: Bangladesh's export receipts from Germany and France fell by nearly $678m in FY26, with garment shipments driving much of the decline. Overall receipts from the European Union fell 2.7% to $19.72bn.
stories.why: The European Union is a major export market for Bangladesh's garment sector, which accounts for most of the country's export earnings. Shifts in EU demand affect Bangladesh's foreign exchange reserves.

stories.headline: Leading African cashew-producing countries hold their 8th Council of Ministers in Abidjan
stories.summary: Leading cashew producing countries held their eighth Council of Ministers in Abidjan. Discussions focused on local industrialisation, market diversification and competitiveness in the face of a 2026 economic slowdown.
stories.why: Cashew is a major export commodity for several West African economies, and producer policy affects global cashew supply and prices. Local processing determines how much value stays in producing countries.

stories.headline: What is known about EU import quotas on hybrid cars from China, Mexico and other countries?
stories.summary: The EU has set import quotas for hybrid vehicles, including a quota for China, and quotas covering Japan, the UK, the United States and Mexico.

stories.summary: The Insurance Development and Regulatory Authority suspended the marine cargo business of Green Delta and BGIC for three months, effective November 5, over insurance law violations.
stories.why: Green Delta and BGIC are Bangladeshi insurers, and regulator suspensions affect their revenue and policyholder confidence.

stories.headline: Tinubu seeks N3.15tn cut in 2026 budget, retains N31.46tn deficit
stories.summary: President Tinubu asked the House to cut the 2026 budget from N68.32tn to N65.18tn, retaining the N31.46tn deficit. He cited existing obligations and available resources.
stories.why: Nigeria's federal budget sets public spending and borrowing needs for Africa's largest economy, shaping its fiscal outlook, naira-denominated debt and investor sentiment toward its sovereign bonds.

stories.headline: China extends to January pause on export ban to US of key minerals for semiconductors
stories.summary: China's Commerce Ministry extended its suspension of export bans on various minerals and metals to the United States until January 27. The minerals are important for semiconductors.
stories.why: Critical minerals such as gallium and germanium feed chip supply chains, so export curbs affect semiconductor makers and US-China trade.

stories.why: Bilateral agribusiness and energy agreements can shape investment flows and trade in key sectors between the two economies.

stories.headline: Tanzania Avocado Exports Hit 52,000 Tonnes and USD 97.2 million, Beating 2030 Target
stories.summary: Tanzania's avocado exports reached 52,000 tonnes in the 2025/2026 season, beating the 2030 target of 40,000 tonnes, with export earnings up 120.4% to USD 97.2 million.
stories.why: Horticultural exports are a source of foreign currency for Tanzania, and growth in agricultural shipments affects farm incomes and trade balances.

stories.headline: Tanzania Financial Markets Week to 30 October 2026: 20-Year Bond Yield Falls to 10.5214%, Shilling Eases to TZS 2,640.73/USD
stories.summary: Tanzania's 20-year Treasury bond yield fell to 10.5214% from 11.3306% in the week to 30 October, with the auction oversubscribed by TZS 670.08 billion. The shilling eased 0.15%.
stories.why: Long-dated government bond yields signal borrowing costs and investor demand for sovereign debt, which matter for pricing across the local fixed-income market.

stories.headline: Tanzania Financial Markets Week to 23 October 2026: Interbank FX Turnover Triples to USD 60.80 Million, Shilling Eases to TZS 2,636.74/USD
stories.summary: Interbank foreign exchange turnover rose to USD 60.80 million from USD 19.70 million. The shilling eased 0.14% to TZS 2,636.74 per dollar, while the 7-day interbank rate fell to 6.59%.
stories.why: Shilling moves and interbank rates shape borrowing costs and currency risk for banks, companies and investors exposed to Tanzania.

stories.headline: Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange Week 44 of 2026: Equity Turnover Surges +147.30% to TZS 41.66 Billion as NMG (+30.23%) Leads as Best Stock Performer
stories.summary: Equity turnover on the Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange rose 147.30% week-on-week to TZS 41.66 billion in week 44 of 2026, while the DSEI index moved down 2.53%.
stories.why: The Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange is Tanzania's main equity market, and its benchmark index and trading volumes indicate local investor activity and liquidity.

stories.headline: Tanzania Grants TPDC Four Oil and Gas Exploration Licences, Takes Over Songo Songo Gas Field Operations
stories.summary: Tanzania granted the Tanzania Petroleum Development Corporation four oil and gas exploration licences and transferred operations of the Songo Songo gas field to the corporation.
stories.why: The Tanzania Petroleum Development Corporation is the state-owned body that manages the country's petroleum resources, so its licences and field control shape future gas and oil supply.
